subject: MSA/Order Form intake — BrightBridge onboarding & redline inputs
messages:

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA/Order Form intake — BrightBridge onboarding & redline inputs

Hi Marissa/Markus,

Attached are the counterparty MSA and the completed order form from BrightBridge. Elena from BrightBridge copied procurement. This is a new mid-market deal; sales ask is to get legal comments back within 3 business days so we can keep the proposed go-live for their pilot (contracted start: 2026-10-01).

Quick context:
- BrightBridge is onboarding 12 seats for the pilot plus embedding calls; expected monthly usage is moderate (projected token volume included in the order form).
- They require SOC 2 evidence (we already provided the public SOC 2 report last quarter).
- Procurement asked for a standard indemnity and limited liability cap discussion.

Can you:
1) Confirm which MSA version we should use as the baseline (I attached our Redwood_MSA_v1.2).
2) Flag material commercial points in the counterparty redline and indicate anything that needs Sales / Revenue to sign off.
3) Return a marked-up MSA and a short summary (one-pager) of requested changes and recommended position by EOD Friday 2026-09-10.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v1.2.docx (our template), BrightBridge_OrderForm.xlsx (counterparty filled)

Thanks — I can hop on a 20-min sync if useful.

— Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form intake — BrightBridge onboarding & redline inputs

Hannah — thanks for the intake. Markus, initial read-through attached (Redline v1). I pulled the standouts below.

Standout issues from counterparty drafter:
- Broad warranty carveouts and reverse indemnity language in Section 8 (wants us to assume more producer liability).
- Data residency clause asks for EU-only processing for embeddings; they flagged specific subprocessor restrictions.
- Payment terms: net-90 and a right to withhold for alleged breaches (we should push to net-30 / net-45).
- Termination for convenience: their draft gives 30-day right with no pro-rated refund.

My recommended approach:
- Push back on indemnity scope and limit to third-party claims tied to Gross Negligence or Willful Misconduct; keep our indemnity narrow.
- Accept a narrow data residency commitment only if they sign the Addendum for EU hosting and accept our subprocessors list (send to security for evidence).
- Counter to net-45 with 45-day milestone-based payment schedule and escrow language only for large prepayments.

Action items:
- Markus: please review indemnity / liability redlines and advise if any carveouts require executive approval.
- Rishi: can you confirm whether we can accommodate the EU-only processing request via our EU region offering and what the pricing delta would be?

I have attached the marked-up MSA (Redline v1) and a short summary note.

— Marissa Cole
Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form intake — BrightBridge onboarding & redline inputs

Team — thanks Marissa for the first pass. A few notes from legal:

1) Indemnity / liability: I agree with narrowing indemnity to third-party IP claims and claims arising from Customer's use of their own data. We should cap liability at the greater of the fees paid in prior 12 months and $1M; if procurement insists on higher, escalate to Legal Director for exception.

2) Data residency / subprocessors: We can offer EU-only processing if BrightBridge commits to our EU hosting addendum and accepts the current subprocessors list (I will attach the subprocessors table to the follow-up). This is a commercial ask and may affect pricing.

3) Payment terms: net-45 is acceptable for SMB to mid-market; net-90 is not acceptable. Reject hold-to-withhold clauses that are not judgment-based.

4) Termination / refunds: propose pro-rated refund for unused prepaid credits and 30-day cure period for breach before termination for convenience is executed.

Next steps:
- Marissa will run redline v2 with the liability cap language and the EU addendum placeholder.
- Hannah to coordinate pricing delta confirmation from Rishi.
- I will prepare a short exec exception memo template in case procurement pushes higher liability limits.

— Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: Elena Park <elena.park@brightbridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightbridge.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA/Order Form intake — BrightBridge onboarding & redline inputs

Hi Hannah/Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the marked-up MSA. Procurement reviewed internally and asked me to confirm a few items before their legal counsel proceeds with a counter-redline: 

1) Could you confirm whether Redwood's EU hosting addendum can be signed as-is, or if you require list-level agreement on subprocessors first? Procurement prefers to see the full subprocessor list before committing.
2) They also want to know if Redwood can accept a go-live condition tied to receipt of SOC 2 evidence and the signed order form.
3) Finally, they asked whether the pilot seats can be invoiced upfront with a 30% prepayment and the remainder net-45. If so, they would accept net-45 on remaining invoices.

We are aiming to finalize commercial terms this week to keep the kickoff on 2026-10-01. Happy to jump on a short call if that helps — I am available Thu 9/9 between 10-12 PT.

Attachments referenced: BrightBridge_OrderForm.xlsx

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Procurement, BrightBridge Systems
elena.park@brightbridge.com
